HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
Note Purchase Agreement, April 12, 2011
Harbor Labs, LLC sells convertible notes totalling $150,000 to the purchasers on
Schedule 1.
Schedule 1: Lantern Street Seed I, LLC, $99,000. Angie Angel, $30,000. Sam Seed,
$21,000.
Interest: 6 percent a year, simple. Maturity: April 12, 2012.

HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 2 of 2
Conversion. On a qualified financing of at least $1,000,000 in new money, the
principal converts into the shares sold in that financing at a 20 percent discount
to the price paid by new investors.
There is no valuation cap.
Accrued interest is paid in cash at conversion.
Successor. If the company converts to a corporation, the corporation takes on these
notes.
Amendment. The holders of a majority of the principal may amend or extend all of the
notes.
